title: Card Payments on the Calendar
subtitle: The Elan card payment shows on the 16th, bills charged to the card are counted once, and a late Venmo childcare payment counts for the Friday before it.
intro: The code is already in your Sheet. One new column, Payment Due Day, is added at the end of the Accounts table by the upgrade.
**What does not change:** no transactions, balances, bills or paychecks. The Financial Summary and every other total stay as they are; only the calendar changes.

steps.text: In the Sheet, open **File → Version history → Name current version** and name it `Before card payments 2026-11-16`.
Reload the Sheet. Open the **App Setup** tab and check that **Build Script Version** reads `1.28.0`. If it shows an older number, wait a minute and reload again.
Open **Finance Tracker → Upgrade workbook (keeps data)** and confirm.
On **App Setup**, look at the Settings section.
steps.done: **PSLF count reminder after (months)** shows `12` (not a date) and **Balance reminder after (months…)** shows `6` (not $6.00).

steps.text: Open the **Accounts** tab and find the row **Elan Credit Card ····7763** (ACC-017). Scroll right to the last column, **Payment Due Day**, and type `16`.
Open **Finance Tracker → Bills & paychecks calendar…** and look at November 16.
steps.done: **Elan Credit Card payment** shows as Paid with the payment the bank recorded on Nov 6.

steps.text: Look at November 11 (Netflix, Audible) and the 3rd (YMCA, Apple).
steps.done: These bills charged to the Elan card are faded. Click one: it says it is counted once, in the Elan card payment.

steps.text: Click **›** to go to December and look at the 16th.
steps.done: The Elan payment shows what you owe on the card now (the same amount as on the Financial Summary), marked with * as an estimate.

steps.text: Look at the Fridays in November.
steps.done: A childcare payment that showed up a few days after a Friday counts for that Friday, not the next one.

steps.text: The one QA check that failed earlier: in **Extensions → Apps Script → Executions**, open the latest **runQA** and copy the line that starts with **FAIL**. Also tell me anything on the calendar that looks wrong.
